brief.headline: Nifty tops 25500 as Goldman upgrades India; US stocks slump overnight
brief.summary: Nifty 50 closed at 25514.3 as auto and banking stocks led gains, while Goldman Sachs upgraded Indian equities to Overweight with a December 2027 Nifty target of 28,500. Overnight, US markets sold off sharply with the S&P 500 falling 2.02% and Nasdaq down 2.25%. Anthropic completed its historic $81 billion IPO, debuting on Nasdaq at $111.

takeaways.text: Goldman Sachs upgraded Indian equities to Overweight with a December 2027 Nifty target of 28,500, citing earnings demand and foreign investment.
Nifty Auto index rose nearly 4% led by Maruti as lower crude prices at 90.15 eased input cost concerns for automakers.
S&P 500 sank 2.02% and Nasdaq dropped 2.25% overnight as Fed officials highlighted persistent inflation risks.
Anthropic debuted on Nasdaq at $111 after raising $81.3 billion in its record initial public offering.
Defence stocks HAL, BEL, and BDL jumped up to 3% following reports of a proposed 20% capex hike in Budget 2027.
JPMorgan maintained Overweight on Reliance Industries with a ₹1,675 target price, seeing 23% upside.

sections.india: Nifty 50 advanced 1.14% to 25514.3 while Bank Nifty rose 1.65% to 63063.0. Goldman Sachs upgraded India to Overweight with a December 2027 target of 28,500. Tata Tech surged over 9% on its FY30 target of $1.1-1.3 billion revenue, while defense stocks gained up to 3% on proposed capex increases.
sections.world: US equities slid overnight with S&P 500 falling 2.02% to 7175.83 and Nasdaq slumping 2.25% to 23879.2. J.P. Morgan projected Federal Reserve rate hikes across the next three meetings amid sticky inflation. Brent Crude dropped 1.96% to 90.15 as US sour crude war premiums dissolved.
sections.tech: Anthropic completed its $81 billion IPO, opening on Nasdaq at $111 per share before paring initial gains. Google updated Gemini to control Mac devices directly for multistep workflows. AMD plunged 8% after reports linked its firmware to blacklisted Chinese firms.
